title: Man City's 115 charges, explained
checked: State as of 4 Nov 2026. Charged 6 Feb 2023: 54 financial information, 14 pay, 7 PSR + 5 UEFA FFP, 35 cooperation (Wikipedia, ESPN). Hearing 16 Sep to 6 Dec 2024 (Wikipedia, Flashscore). Verdict confirmed 29 Sep 2026: all financial charges, most cooperation charges; 114 of 115 reported (AP/NBC, Wikipedia, Yahoo). Sham sponsorship, more than £900m (AP, Wikipedia). Masters quote (AP via NBC News, NBC Sports). City 'disappointed and surprised', 'clear material errors... unsafe', appeal lodged 1 Oct (Yahoo, Dragon Football, Ahram). No sanction yet; separate hearing after the appeal; possible fines, points, relegation, expulsion (Wikipedia, AP). No appeal date found: left out. Takeover 2008 and titles 2012/14/18 are general record.

lines.text: One hundred and fifteen charges. Nine seasons. And after nearly three years, a verdict.

scene.heading: THE 115
scene.sub: Manchester City v the Premier League

lines.text: February 2023. The Premier League drops a bombshell on its own champions.
lines.say: February, twenty twenty-three. The Premier League drops a bombshell on its own champions.

scene.headline: Manchester City charged with 115 breaches of financial rules
scene.standfirst: The league refers nine seasons, 2009-10 to 2017-18, to an independent commission.

lines.text: Fifty-four on accounts. Fourteen on player and manager pay. Twelve on spending rules. Thirty-five for not cooperating.
Those were the years City became a superpower. Bought by Abu Dhabi in 2008, champions three times.
lines.say: Those were the years City became a superpower. Bought by Abu Dhabi in two thousand and eight, champions three times.

lines.text: The hearing ran from September to December 2024. Then silence, for almost two years.
lines.say: The hearing ran from September to December, twenty twenty-four. Then silence, for almost two years.

lines.text: Then, on the twenty-ninth of September 2026, it landed.
lines.say: Then, on the twenty-ninth of September, twenty twenty-six, it landed.

scene.headline: Manchester City found guilty of breaking Premier League financial rules
scene.standfirst: An independent commission upholds every financial charge across nine seasons, and most of the charges for not cooperating.

lines.text: Every financial charge proven. Reports say one hundred and fourteen of the one hundred and fifteen.
The commission found sham sponsorship deals that boosted City's income and cut their costs, by more than nine hundred million pounds.
League boss Richard Masters: the club systematically broke the rules for nearly a decade.

scene.text: The club systematically broke Premier League rules for nearly a decade.

lines.text: City said they were disappointed and surprised, called the ruling unsafe, and appealed.

scene.headline: City appeal against 115 verdict
scene.standfirst: The club says the ruling has “clear material errors, of law, principle and fact” and insists it is innocent.

lines.text: So right now, there is no punishment. The appeal comes first, then a separate hearing on sanctions.
And the punishment could be anything. A fine. A points deduction. Relegation. Even expulsion.
Guilty, but not yet punished. The biggest case in Premier League history isn't over.
Follow for more, and play Road to Ballon d'Or.
